headline: Discount Retailer Poundland Enters Administration
summary: Discount chain Poundland has collapsed into administration after failing to secure a buyer. The insolvency puts approximately 11,000 jobs at risk.
why: Poundland is a major UK-based discount retailer; its collapse highlights significant distress in the brick-and-mortar retail sector.

impacts.name: Poundland
impacts.why: The company has entered administration, signaling insolvency.
